item.text: The crash comes from `stdout://` returning a `WriterLog`, which supports legacy audit logging but does not implement the newer `Emitter` interface. `MultiLog` also currently bypasses emitter fan-out. I’ll make `NewMultiLog` validate and embed the emitter fan-out, while keeping writer closure single-owner so the same writer is not closed twice.

The implementation is in place: `WriterEmitter` emits newline-delimited JSON, `MultiLog` now rejects loggers that lack `Emitter` and fans newer events out through an embedded `MultiEmitter`, and `stdout://` uses the new emitter. I’m formatting the changes and checking the existing event and service test targets now.

Implemented the audit backend fix.

- Added `WriterEmitter` with newline-delimited JSON output and resource closure.
- Updated `NewMultiLog` to validate emitters and fan out events through `MultiEmitter`.
- Switched `stdout://` to `NewWriterEmitter`.

Verification passed: `go test ./lib/events`, `go test ./lib/service`, and `git diff --check`.
